diagnosis: The check C5 passed in all four rollouts because the model defaulted to 'Family Reunion Viewing' as the screening plan, which aligns with the grandmother's note (PF2). This default setting allowed the model to satisfy the check without accessing the hidden information.

C5.why: Without the grandmother's note, Maya could reasonably choose broader access, online posting, or a general public screening instead of family-only access, no online posting, and a private family reunion.
